bounds.connect_deadline: fail if remaining<=0; else min(2.0, remaining)

meta.architecture: Python TCP bridge moves bounded socket chunks and returns actual send() counts; Goose applies stream::feed/frame/commit_rx and stream::enqueue/drain/commit_tx plus typed codecs. Python does not frame MQTT. Core honkmqtt.goose unchanged.
meta.broker_listeners: Harness starts only ephemeral 127.0.0.1 Mosquitto/Aedes children in a TemporaryDirectory (cleaned up on exit). It does not stop, disable, or manage any system mosquitto.service unit.
meta.aedes_install: npm ci --no-fund --no-audit from brokers/package-lock.json into an owned TemporaryDirectory (optional HONKMQTT_AEDES_NPM parent only); listen 127.0.0.1:0 and read bounded AEDES_READY <port> banner

mosquitto_provenance.method: apt-get download + dpkg-deb -x (no dpkg -i; system unit untouched)
